origin_stage_rows.seed_relation: Distinct from the seed's general staged localization/validation finding: it adds one bounded candidate-conditioned repository retrieval after an initial map, with an explicit counterexample search.
origin_stage_rows.source_locator: RepoCoder, §1, pp. 2471–2472; ACL Anthology PDF lines 10–28 and 52–71. The abstract and method opening describe iterative retrieval-generation using generated completion context and report superiority to vanilla retrieval-augmented completion in repository code-completion experiments.
origin_stage_rows.publication_status: Peer-reviewed EMNLP 2023 proceedings paper; independently confirmed by ACL Anthology metadata (Proceedings, pages 2471–2484, DOI 10.18653/v1/2023.emnlp-main.151).
origin_stage_rows.content_access: Full text available; inspected abstract and opening method section.
origin_stage_rows.support: Direct support for the candidate-conditioned iterative retrieval mechanism and reported completion-task comparison. The case report's additional claims about instability across further iterations and low-duplication limits were not reached in this verifier's inspected lines and remain unconfirmed here.
origin_stage_rows.applicability: Adequately bounded as a workflow inference, not a measured research-prompt effect. Paper task is repository-level code completion, not architecture research or subagent coordination. Candidate-shaped retrieval may reinforce an initial hypothesis; the proposed discriminator appropriately asks for contrary evidence too.
origin_stage_rows.novelty: Meaningful incremental mechanism relative to the four retained seed findings; not another name for staged research or independent claim verification.
origin_stage_rows.next_discriminator: Compare map-only with map plus one hypothesis-conditioned lookup that seeks supporting and contrary callers/examples/tests; record decision relevance and whether evidence changes the hypothesis.

errors_or_gaps: Iteration-stability and low-duplication caveats in the continuation report are not independently verified in the inspected source passages.
No direct evidence that this code-completion mechanism improves smaller-model architecture research or mixed-model handoffs.

origin_stage_rows.stage: continuation; incremental peer-reviewed evidence, qualified at abstract-supported scope
origin_stage_rows.seed_relation: Adds human–AI decision-dialogue evidence on decision quality versus dialogue length, absent from the seed's software-agent, verification, ideation, and benchmark findings.
origin_stage_rows.source_locator: Lin et al., Decision-Oriented Dialogue for Human-AI Collaboration, abstract and front matter, TACL vol. 12 (2024), pp. 892–911. The verified abstract specifies three dialogue domains and reports lower LM rewards despite longer dialogues. The report's narrower §7.2 claims about generic questions and superficially changing proposals were not directly inspected in that section during verification.
origin_stage_rows.publication_status: Peer-reviewed TACL journal article; independently confirmed by ACL Anthology venue/volume/pages/DOI metadata and the PDF front matter publication date (August 2024).
origin_stage_rows.content_access: Full PDF accessible; abstract/front matter directly inspected. Specific §7.2 detail remains unverified by this verifier.
origin_stage_rows.support: Qualified only for the abstract-supported finding that longer LM dialogues did not imply better decision outcomes in the studied domains. Do not credit the more specific generic-question result or proposal-iteration detail without direct §7.2 confirmation.
origin_stage_rows.applicability: The work studies GPT-3 and human assistants in reviewer assignment, itinerary planning, and group travel; it does not study repository research, smaller-model subagents, current model routing, or architecture decisions. Its bounded implication is to measure decision quality and reviewer/communication effort, rather than report length alone.
origin_stage_rows.novelty: Distinct decision-process evidence and an evaluation criterion beyond the seed's repository repair pipeline and evidence-verification studies.
origin_stage_rows.next_discriminator: On matched repository decisions, compare follow-ups requiring a decision-critical unknown and falsifier with generic follow-up; assess useful evidence, missed alternatives, decision quality, and reviewer time.

origin_stage_rows.content_access: Full arXiv HTML accessible, but this verifier directly inspected the title and abstract only; the report's precise expected-marginal-payoff definition, controlled-study result, and designed-complementarity limitation were not verified in the relevant sections.
origin_stage_rows.support: Abstract-level topic is real, but the submitted finding combines a mismatched title/identity and detailed claims not confirmed in relevant primary-source passages. Unresolved; excluded from qualified lower bound.

origin_stage_rows.novelty: Potentially novel relative to seed; not credited until source identity and content are verified.
origin_stage_rows.next_discriminator: Correct the title and source identity, then inspect the paper's framework, experiment, and limitation sections directly; preserve the report's precise paper/operation provenance.
